steps.en: Install it; the gliner extra allows extraction with no LLM key
steps.zh: 安装；带上 gliner 扩展就能不用 LLM key 做抽取

steps.en: Feed it text, documents or code into a named dataset
steps.zh: 把文本、文档或代码喂进一个命名数据集

steps.en: Chunks it and extracts entities and relationships into a graph
steps.zh: 切块，抽出实体和关系写进图谱

steps.en: Embeds the chunks and stores graph, vectors and metadata in local files
steps.zh: 给文本块做 embedding，把图、向量、元数据存进本地文件

steps.en: Ask a question against that dataset
Routes the question to graph traversal and/or vector search and returns the evidence
steps.zh: 把问题分派给图遍历和 / 或向量检索，返回证据

value.en: Multi-hop answers over connected sources without assembling a chunker, extractor, graph DB and vector store yourself
value.zh: 跨关联资料的多跳回答，而不用自己拼切块器、抽取器、图数据库和向量库

sources: https://github.com/topoteretes/cognee README (main @ 2026-10-08): Quickstart `uv pip install "cognee[gliner]"`; `await cognee.remember(..., dataset_name="local_quickstart")`; `await cognee.recall(..., datasets=["local_quickstart"])`; How Cognee works (entities, relationships, chunks; retrieval selects graph, vector or code context); remember/recall/improve/forget table
.env.template: DB_PROVIDER=sqlite, VECTOR_DB_PROVIDER=lancedb, GRAPH_DATABASE_PROVIDER=kuzu; pyproject.toml v1.6.3: ladybug graph engine, lancedb, fastembed
